notes:
The physical locking mechanism itself, as distinguished from the key. An older, more specific word than the broader ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧, which in everyday speech refers to both the lock and the key. {錠前|じょうまえ} is composed of ⟦{錠|じょう}→錠：19340_jou⟧ (lock, bolt) and ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧, where ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ indicates the front-facing part of the mechanism.
